verdict.rationale: Sprinto's questionnaire evidence covers the opposite workflow. It sends security questionnaires to vendors and supports AI-assisted review of vendor due diligence. Nothing shows AI drafting answers to inbound customer questionnaires from the company's own controls and knowledge base, and the vendor-side features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
